integrity_notes: The main assertion is proved by a tagged-site survival bound and coupling. Finite exact arithmetic checks are supplementary, not a substitute for proof. References distinguish established background results from the new claim.
scientific_limitations: Graph substrate K_(n,n,r), rate-one uniform eligible-edge proposals; no claim about embedded physical lattices or rate heterogeneity.
The explicit error bound need not be optimal. The half-normal limit is proved for \(r=o(n^{1/3})\).
Some older greedy-matching sources were accessible only as abstracts; no priority guarantee is made.
title: A binomial vacancy law for dimer jamming with a dilute third sublattice
